theorem lg_target (r : NNReal) : HasSum (fun n => Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial) 1 := by
  let f := fun n => Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial
  let s := ∑' f
  have h0 : 0 < Real.exp (-↑r) := Real.exp_pos (0 < ↑r)
  have h1 : ∀ n, 0 < ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial := λ n, (Real.pow_pos (0 < ↑r) n).div (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.zero_ne_factorial n))
  have h2 : ∀ n, 0 < f n := λ n, (Real.mul_pos h0 (h1 n))
  have h3 : ∀ n, f n ≤ Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r^n / ↑n.factorial := λ n, rfl
  have h4 : ∑' f = Real.exp (-↑r) * ∑' (fun n => ↑r^n / ↑n.factorial) :=
    by rw [∑'_mul_left, Real.mul_assoc, Real.mul_comm]
  have h5 : ∑' (fun n => ↑r^n / ↑n.factorial) = Real.exp ↑r :=
    by apply Real.exp_series_sum
  rw [h4, h5]
  exact Real.mul_eq_one_iff_right (Real.exp_pos (0 < ↑r)) (Real.exp_neg_eq_inv (Real.exp_pos (0 < ↑r)))
